title: Translations 'Missing Translations' chip can never match an entry
body:
## Summary
The Translations-tab 'Missing Translations' preset filters on status === 'pending', a status no producer emits, so the chip always empties the list.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/useLocalizationPipelineView.ts filters `e.status === 'pending'` for the 'missing-translations' translation preset. The only producer, src/lib/localization/translation-engine.ts:110, emits 'translated' or 'needs_review'; a missing translation has no entry at all, so an entry list can never show it. Fixed is either removing the chip or synthesizing per-(string, locale) missing rows - a product call. (The Strings-tab preset of the same name was fixed this round, cbc50723.)

## Flow
- user opens Translations, clicks 'Missing Translations'
- filter keeps entries with status 'pending'
- 0 rows on every run

## Expected impact
Operators stop meeting a filter that always says zero. Nothing can depend on it (it never matched).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a filter chip that answers truthfully
Before: 0 of N entries match on every run (0 producers of 'pending')
After: n/a until the operator picks remove vs synthesize
Method: probe - producer grep; the build rung needs the product decision
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
instrument: operator: remove the chip, or synthesize missing (string, locale) rows

title: Label simulated '[DE] source' translations as simulated
body:
## Summary
The fallback translation is a fabricated '[LOCALE] source' string with an RNG confidence, but the Translations and QA tabs present it like real output; only the scan carries provenance.

## Description
src/lib/localization/translation-engine.ts:95-97 produces `[LOCALE] sourceText` with confidence 0.6 + rng()*0.2 for any string not in the small DB. The view labels the scan's provenance (src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/index.tsx loc-scan-provenance) but src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/TranslationsTab.tsx and src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/QATab.tsx never say the translations are simulated, and src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/TranslationCard.tsx paints the random confidence in a ProgressRing. Fixed: the route returns translation provenance (glossary / db / simulated counts) and both tabs print it.

## Flow
- run the pipeline on a real project
- Translations shows '[DE] Inventory' with a 7x% ring
- nothing says no translator ran

## Expected impact
Operators read Translation % and QA verdicts knowing what is real. Touches route + store (other contexts).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - simulated output is never presented as translation
Before: 0 of 2 translation tabs label simulated entries
After: 2 of 2 (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked fixture run, DB-hit run, no-DB run; build needs route+store edits outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test: Translations tab renders a 'simulated' label when the route marks entries as fallback-generated

title: Escape quotes in the NSLOCTEXT replacement suggestion
body:
## Summary
The replacement suggestion embeds sourceText in a C++ string literal unescaped, so a source containing a quote yields code that does not compile - the pair of the String Table CSV bug fixed this round.

## Description
src/lib/localization/scan-engine.ts:354 and :357 build NSLOCTEXT("ns", "key", "<sourceText>") by interpolation. A source `Press "E" to interact` or one with a backslash produces a broken literal, which src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/ReplacementCard.tsx 'Copy suggested' hands to the operator. Fixed: escape backslash and double-quote when emitting. Pair: StringTableCard CSV quoting fixed in b4109236.

## Flow
- scan a file with a quoted source literal
- Overview > LOCTEXT Replacement Suggestions > Copy suggested
- pasted code fails to compile

## Expected impact
Copied suggestions compile. A snapshot of replacements, if any, re-pins.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - generated C++ compiles
Before: 1 of 1 quoted source yields a broken literal (walked)
After: 0 of 1 (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked the template; the lib file is outside this context's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: unit test: generateLOCTEXTReplacements on a source with a quote and a backslash yields an escaped literal

title: Duplicate LOCTEXT keys emitted into one String Table
body:
## Summary
generateStringTable groups by namespace without deduplicating keys, so one literal found in two files yields two rows with one key - a duplicate React key in StringTableCard and a duplicate key in the UE CSV.

## Description
src/lib/localization/scan-engine.ts:255 derives locKey from text+context (generateLocKey hashes the text) while the string id includes filePath; generateStringTable (:372-392) emits one row per string. src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/StringTableCard.tsx renders rows with key={row.key}. Fixed: merge rows sharing (namespace, key, source) and flag a collision when sources differ.

## Flow
- the literal 'Inventory' appears in Hud.cpp and Menu.cpp
- String Tables lists Inventory_xxxx twice
- UE import warns on duplicate key; React warns on duplicate key

## Expected impact
One row per key in the shipped CSV. Row counts in the tab drop.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one row per key
Before: 2 rows / 1 key for the walked case
After: 1 row (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked scanFromUnits + generateStringTable; lib is outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: unit test: two units with the same text in different files -> one row for that key

title: Make the full LOCTEXT replacement list reachable
body:
## Summary
Overview shows 10 replacement suggestions and says '+N more - switch to Strings tab for full list', but the Strings tab never renders replacements, so suggestions 11+ are unreachable.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/OverviewTab.tsx renders replacements.slice(0, 10) with the 'switch to Strings tab' hint; src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/StringsTab.tsx / StringCard.tsx show source, context, key and snippets only, and `replacements` is consumed by OverviewTab alone. Fixed: a 'Show all' expander in place, or a replacement panel inside StringCard keyed by stringId.

## Flow
- scan with 25 hardcoded strings
- Overview: 10 cards and '+15 more - switch to Strings tab'
- Strings tab: no suggested code anywhere

## Expected impact
Operators can copy every suggestion, not the first ten. Small layout change on Overview.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every suggestion reachable
Before: 10 of N suggestions reachable
After: N of N (predicted)
Method: simulation - consumer grep + walked flow; the fix shape (expander vs StringCard panel) is a choice
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/OverviewTab.tsx '+{replacements.length - 10} more - switch to Strings tab for full list'
grep replacements in LocalizationPipelineView -> index.tsx (pass-through) and OverviewTab.tsx only
instrument: component test: with 12 replacements, all 12 suggestedCode strings are reachable

title: TranslationCard expansion bar shows the locale constant, not the entry
body:
## Summary
Each TranslationCard draws its expansion bar from the locale's static expansionFactor, so every German card shows the same +35% bar regardless of the translation's real length.

## Description
src/components/modules/evaluator/LocalizationPipelineView/TranslationCard.tsx draws width from locInfo.expansionFactor (now on the shared MAX_EXPANSION scale, 51b76459) and labels formatExpansion(locInfo.expansionFactor); the entry's measured delta (entry.charDelta) is printed as text below it. Fixed: bar from translatedText.length / sourceText.length with the locale factor as a marker.

## Flow
- Translations, locale de
- 'Inventar' (shorter than source) shows a +35% bar
- the bar contradicts '-1 chars vs source' under it

## Expected impact
The bar answers 'does THIS string grow?'. Visual change on every card.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - bar reflects the entry
Before: bar equals the locale constant on 100% of cards
After: bar from measured ratio (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked shorter / equal / longer entries; whether the locale constant belongs on a per-entry card is a design call
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test: two de entries of different lengths render different bar widths
